parameters.name: TB1
parameters.scientific_note: Base temperature for vegetative development (stage 1 cardinal point).

parameters.name: TB2
parameters.scientific_note: Base temperature for early reproductive development (stage 2 cardinal point).

parameters.name: TB3
parameters.scientific_note: Base temperature for late reproductive development (stage 3 cardinal point).

parameters.name: TO11
parameters.scientific_note: Lower optimum temperature for vegetative development (stage 1).

parameters.name: TO12
parameters.scientific_note: Lower optimum temperature for early reproductive development (stage 2).

parameters.name: TO13
parameters.scientific_note: Lower optimum temperature for late reproductive development (stage 3).

parameters.name: TO21
parameters.scientific_note: Upper optimum temperature for vegetative development (stage 1).

parameters.name: TO22
parameters.scientific_note: Upper optimum temperature for early reproductive development (stage 2).

parameters.name: TO23
parameters.scientific_note: Upper optimum temperature for late reproductive development (stage 3).

parameters.name: TM1
parameters.scientific_note: Maximum (ceiling) temperature for vegetative development (stage 1).

parameters.name: TM2
parameters.scientific_note: Maximum (ceiling) temperature for early reproductive development (stage 2).

parameters.name: TM3
parameters.scientific_note: Maximum (ceiling) temperature for late reproductive development (stage 3).

parameters.name: EM-FL
parameters.scientific_note: Emergence to first flower duration (photothermal time).

parameters.name: FL-SH
parameters.scientific_note: First flower to first pod/shell duration; must precede FL-SD.

parameters.name: FL-SD
parameters.scientific_note: First flower to first seed duration.

parameters.name: PODUR
parameters.scientific_note: Time from first pod to last pod (podding duration). Also declared in fruit_set module.

parameters.name: SDPDV
parameters.scientific_note: Seed period duration variability. Also declared in fruit_set module.

parameters.name: SFDUR
parameters.scientific_note: Seed fill duration. Also declared in fruit_growth module.

parameters.name: LNGSH
parameters.scientific_note: Long-shield/shelf fill duration; constrained LNGSH.init <= XMPAGE.init. Also declared in fruit_growth module.

parameters.name: XMAGE
parameters.scientific_note: Harvest age (max physiological age of fruit); constrained XMAGE.init <= XMPAGE.init. Also declared in fruit_growth module.

parameters.name: XMPAGE
parameters.scientific_note: Maximum physiological age of the fruit pool; upper anchor for LNGSH and XMAGE ordering constraints. Also declared in fruit_growth module.

parameters.name: FL-LF
parameters.scientific_note: Flowering to leaf duration. Currently FIXED at 400 (indeterminate) and not varied; declared existing_v4 but kept fixed.

parameters.name: FL-VS
parameters.scientific_note: Flowering to vegetative-stage termination duration.
